title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.329 - Added a `system/informational` warning, tagged `managed_hooks_not_loaded`, when hooks in managed settings fail to load - Added `permissions.workingDirectoriesExclude` to the `Settings` type: paths, read only from `--settings` and settings the host sends, that the working-directory read and write blocks treat as outside - Fixed sessions bound with `SpareProcess.claim()` ignoring `autoCompactWindow` from the folder's settings or the claim's `settings` - Fixed retained memory when an in-process MCP server does not answer its start-up handshake - Fixed memory growth in long sessions that use `--replay-user-messages`: the SDK no longer keeps echoes of its own tool results and permission answers - Fixed an MCP server that a plugin started at launch staying connected after the plugin was disabled or uninstalled and `reload_plugins` ran, in headless and SDK sessions - Fixed `rewind_conversation` removing history under a message sent right after a model change: the request is now refused with "commands queued", and callers can send it again - Improved memory use of idle SDK sessions: after 30 seconds idle, large tool result data that no model request reads is released, except while Remote Control is on
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
